description: Set up translated voice calls on WhatsApp or in the browser, list call languages and rooms, and check remaining minutes.

defaultPrompt: Set up a WhatsApp call with my contractor, who speaks Spanish.
Make a call room for talking to my mother-in-law in Portuguese.
Show my VoiceCallTranslator rooms and remaining translation minutes.
interface.longDescription: VoiceCallTranslator holds two-person voice calls where each person hears the other translated into their own language, live, in 41 languages, like having an interpreter on the call. A call can be an ordinary WhatsApp voice call to VoiceCallTranslator's WhatsApp number, or a call in the browser. Ask ChatGPT to set up a call and it creates a room on your VoiceCallTranslator account and gives you what to send the other person and how to start the call yourself. The other person needs no app and no account. You can also see your rooms and how many translation minutes you have left. ChatGPT creates rooms and shows account information; you make the call yourself, on WhatsApp or on VoiceCallTranslator. It does not send invitations, join or listen to calls, or purchase minutes.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: first release. Four tools: list call languages, create a call room (on WhatsApp or in the browser), list rooms, and report the minutes left. The plugin sells nothing, processes no payments and links to no checkout or pricing page.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Its four tools list call languages, create rooms, list rooms, and report the remaining minutes balance; none links to pricing or checkout or mentions buying. A VoiceCallTranslator account and its minutes are managed only on voicecalltranslator.com, outside ChatGPT. Creating a room is free, and guests never pay.

negative.prompt: Send the invitation to my grandmother on WhatsApp.
negative.description: Sending invitations is unsupported. Explain that the user must send the invitation themselves. Do not invoke tools to send a message or claim an invitation was delivered.

negative.prompt: Call my mum now and translate what we say.
negative.description: Starting, joining, listening to, and translating a live call within ChatGPT are unsupported. ChatGPT may create a room, but must explain that the user starts the call themselves, from WhatsApp or the host link. Do not claim a live call is underway.

Purchasing is unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot buy minutes and that minutes are managed in the user's VoiceCallTranslator account. Do not invoke a purchase action, link to checkout or a pricing page, or claim a payment was made.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_call_languages with no arguments. Report the 41 returned language names and codes accurately; do not invent additional supported languages.
positive.prompt: Which languages can a VoiceCallTranslator call use?
positive.description: Use a signed-in dedicated reviewer account. Verify the live language catalogue.

positive.expected_behavior: Call create_call_room with call_from="whatsapp" and guest_language="es", omitting host_language to use the account default. Return VoiceCallTranslator's WhatsApp number, the invitation for the guest, and the host link, with their purposes clearly distinguished. If the answer says the user's WhatsApp number is not connected yet, relay how to connect it on the rooms page. Do not send the invitation or start a call.
positive.prompt: Set up a WhatsApp call with my contractor, who speaks Spanish.
positive.description: Use the reviewer account. Creating a room must neither reserve nor deduct minutes.

positive.expected_behavior: Call create_call_room with host_language="fr" and guest_language="ja" (call_from omitted or "browser"). An optional room_name may be supplied. Present the returned guest and host links correctly and identify French and Japanese. Do not start a call.
positive.prompt: Set up a call in the browser where I speak French and my guest speaks Japanese.
positive.description: Use the signed-in reviewer account. Verify explicit host and guest language selection.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_my_rooms with no arguments. Present the returned open rooms newest first, accurately reflecting whether each is a WhatsApp or a browser room, its languages, last-call information and links. Include both newly created test rooms. Do not fabricate missing data.
positive.description: Use the reviewer account after the two room creation cases, so it contains known open rooms.

positive.expected_behavior: Call list_my_rooms and get_minutes_balance with no arguments. Report the actual returned open rooms and the minutes left. Room creation alone must not reduce the balance. The response contains no purchase or pricing link.
positive.prompt: Show my VoiceCallTranslator rooms and remaining translation minutes.
positive.description: Use the reviewer account with known remaining minutes. Compare its balance before and after room creation; no calls should be joined during testing.
